title: Tiny, cute teapot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow under teapot -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="84" rx="28" ry="5" fill="#3a2b5c" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- spout -->
  <path d="M68 52 Q80 48 84 38 Q86 33 82 32 Q78 31 76 36 Q73 44 66 47 Z" fill="#ff8fab" stroke="#ffb3c6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d="M30 44 Q16 40 14 52 Q12 64 28 62" fill="none" stroke="#ff6b8a" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M30 44 Q18 42 17 52 Q16 62 28 60" fill="none" stroke="#ffb3c6" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="49" cy="60" rx="26" ry="22" fill="#ff8fab"/>
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="56" rx="18" ry="14" fill="#ffb3c6" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- lid -->
  <ellipse cx="49" cy="40" rx="20" ry="7" fill="#ff6b8a"/>
  <ellipse cx="49" cy="39" rx="16" ry="4" fill="#ffb3c6" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- knob -->
  <circle cx="49" cy="33" r="5" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <circle cx="47" cy="31" r="2" fill="#fff3b0" opacity="0.8"/>
  
  <!-- base -->
  <ellipse cx="49" cy="80" rx="20" ry="6" fill="#ff6b8a"/>
  <ellipse cx="49" cy="79" rx="16" ry="3.5" fill="#ffb3c6" opacity="0.4"/>
  
  <!-- cute face on body -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="58" r="3.5" fill="#5c3d6e"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="58" r="3.5" fill="#5c3d6e"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="57" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="57" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="64" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#ff5c7a" opacity="0.6"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="64" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#ff5c7a" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 65 Q49 70 54 65" fill="none" stroke="#5c3d6e" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- decoration dots -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="72" r="2" fill="#ffd166" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="74" r="2" fill="#ffd166" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="72" r="2" fill="#ffd166" opacity="0.8"/>
</svg>
